purpose: Form ADT-2 is used to apply to the Central Government for the removal of an auditor before the expiry of their term under Rule 7.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within thirty days of the resolution passed by the Board.
steps: Pass a Board resolution for the removal of the auditor.
File the application in Form ADT-2 with the Central Government within thirty days of the Board resolution.
Pay the fees provided under the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
Receive approval from the Central Government.
Hold the general meeting within sixty days of receiving the approval to pass the special resolution.
checklist: Prescribed fees under the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014
Notice and arrangements for the general meeting to pass the special resolution
watch: Ensure the application is made within thirty days of the Board resolution and the general meeting is held within sixty days of receiving Central Government approval.
